qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ayush medical officer: Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy & Naturopathy system from a recognized institution, with the prescribed course of study and one-year compulsory internship. | pharmacist: Must possess any of the qualifications D Pharmacy / B. how_to_apply: Download the specific application form corresponding to the post for which you are eligible from the official notification PDF.
Fill in all personal and educational details accurately as per your Aadhaar Card and academic certificates.
Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Attach all required certificates and documents, ensuring they are attested by a Gazetted Officer.
Submit the filled application form in person or send it through Registered Post to the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri Dist before the last date and time.
important_instructions: Applications must be received between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. All required certificates must be attested by a Gazetted Officer. Reservation and selection are as per the applicable Telangana rules and Presidential Order. Candidates must use the application form corresponding specifically to the post for which they are applying.

content_sections.heading: Medchal Malkajgiri District Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available under the National Ayush Mission (NAM) in Medchal Malkajgiri District.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy & Naturopathy system from a recognized institution, with the prescribed course of study and one-year compulsory internship.
Must possess any of the qualifications D Pharmacy / B. Pharmacy / Pharma D Degree and should be registered with Telangana Pharmacy Council subject to the prescribed conditions.
Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) from a recognized University/Institution, as prescribed.
Degree in Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences or Diploma in Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences, subject to the prescribed conditions.
Must have passed VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Medchal Malkajgiri District Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the specific application form corresponding to the post for which you are eligible from the official notification PDF. Fill in all personal and educational details accurately as per your Aadhaar Card and academic certificates. Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the designated space on the application form. Attach all required certificates and documents, ensuring they are attested by a Gazetted Officer. Submit the filled application form in person or send it through Registered Post to the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri Dist before the last date and time.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC / equivalent examination certificate with Bonafide Certificate Intermediate / 10+2 certificate, where applicable with Bonafide Certificate Qualifying examination pass certificate with Bonafide Certificate Marks memos of all years of the qualifying examination Registration certificate of the concerned Board / Council, where applicable PG qualification certificate, where applicable Latest caste certificate, where applicable Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th Class and/or prescribed residency certificate, as applicable Bonafide Certificate from Class 4th to 7th (specifically for MPW post) PwD / PH certificate, where applicable Ex-Service certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted attested copies of all required certificates/documents

content_sections.text: Applications must be received between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. faq.question: Q1. What is Medchal Malkajgiri District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the District Selection Committee, Medchal Malkajgiri District, to engage personnel under the National Ayush Mission (NAM) on an outsourcing basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available across various posts including AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional, and Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The applications will be received up to 22-10-2026 between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01/07/2026, with relaxations as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy & Naturopathy system from a recognized institution with a one-year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: The remuneration for the Pharmacist post is Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person or through Registered Post at the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri Dist.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
